# War Risk Index

War Risk Index is an independent public information site at
https://warriskindex.blog/ for the keyword "war risk index".

The site provides a transparent 0-100 open-news risk pressure signal from recent
GDELT coverage. It compares global and regional conflict-related coverage using
volume, acceleration, source breadth, and recency. It does not claim to predict
war probability, provide investment advice, sell insurance, issue government
analysis, or replace qualified security judgment.

Primary pages:

- https://warriskindex.blog/
- https://warriskindex.blog/methodology/
- https://warriskindex.blog/regions/
- https://warriskindex.blog/sources/

Core sources:

- GDELT Project: https://www.gdeltproject.org/
- GDELT DOC 2.0 API: https://blog.gdeltproject.org/gdelt-doc-2-0-api-debuts/
- ACLED Conflict Index methodology: https://acleddata.com/general-guide/about-conflict-index
- UCDP API documentation: https://ucdp.uu.se/apidocs/
- CFR Global Conflict Tracker methodology: https://www.cfr.org/global-conflict-tracker/methodology
- Wikimedia Analytics API page views: https://doc.wikimedia.org/generated-data-platform/aqs/analytics-api/reference/page-views.html
